This looks great — you've captured everything I asked for, and reading through it I recognize how I'd actually use it. Automatic details on save with the ability to edit, saving a repeat link taking me to the one I already have, the read-later and archive flows, formatted notes, the more powerful search with tags and exact phrases and combining conditions, saving searches I reuse, acting on many at once, bringing my bookmarks in and out, and the display preferences — that's the picture I had in my head.

Your defaults all sound sensible to me too: turning imported folders into tags, new items starting unread, ignoring trivial address differences, not overwriting my existing entries on import, and the newest-first / 25-per-page / normal-text defaults. Good.

The specification is approved. Please go ahead and prepare the implementation plan for the next gate.
